messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional neighborhood repair cafe: bring one broken item, take a numbered ticket, and collect it before volunteers leave. Avoid promotional language. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content:
**Neighborhood Repair Cafe Notice**

Please limit yourself to one broken item per person to ensure everyone is served. 

Upon arrival, take a numbered ticket from the front desk. Watch the display board; volunteers will call your number when they are ready to assist you. 

All repairs must be completed and items collected before our volunteers depart at 4:00 PM. No overnight storage is available.
